Vacuum/low-pressure disc on shark skin. G3-L-7:environment matches water but this is suction physics, not depending on water as a basic need. G3-L-4 is not attachment. Potential destination: none (no animal-suction or pressure-difference competency).

G3-L-7 asks students to observe examples and explain how living things depend on one another to meet basic needs. This card is a concrete, accurate commensalism example: the remora depends on the shark for food (leftover scraps) and a ride, and the shark is not harmed. Only the food-and-shelter facet admits (pattern food|eat|shelter); the environment facet (water|soil|air|sun) does not fire, so every admitted facet is genuinely taught. App vs merged differ only by a restated subject clause in merged ('The remora fish sticks to a shark's body...'); both variants teach the same dependence, so identity is reconciled on the app card ffct-13149. TL ('makakain ng natitirang pagkain — hindi naman nasasaktan ang pating') and BIS ('makakaon sa salin nga pagkaon — wala gyud masakti ang iho') are faithful. Other keyword hits (G4-E-8 stick, G7-E-2 slip, G7-F-9 disadvantage) are homonyms, not this teaching. Parent consolidation verification: Remora relying on shark transport/food scraps directly illustrates food dependence. Both shorter and longer pool variants and all translations checked; same ID and teaching.

evidence.quote:
Why does a remora fish stick to a shark?

To hitch a free ride and eat leftover scraps — and the shark isn't harmed at all.

The single admitted facet (local-examples, pattern includes dry) is the card's actual subject, not a stray keyword. TL/BIS faithfully render mold (amagin / ag-agon) and weevils (bukbok). Not recovered under G5-L-4 (mold hits fungi but the card never classifies living things or uses a table) or G3-L-3 (grows mold is not the living-thing characteristic 'grow'). Parent consolidation verification: BIS ag-agon means sift/sieve, not grow mould. Correct the grain-spoilage translation before recovery; the local drying/storage explanation is otherwise relevant.

G4-L-2 is 'observe the root and shoot system in plants and describe why they are important'. Both currently matching facets are genuinely taught: roots (root.*anchor) — the root anchors the plant in the soil; shoots (stem.*lea) — the stem lifts the leaves and flowers toward the sun. This is the importance half of the competency, not a bare noun-share, and the card need not perform the observation activity. TL/BIS are faithful (ugat/gamot humahawak/mokupot sa lupa; tangkay/punoan nagtataas/mopataas ng dahon). Parent consolidation verification: Root anchorage and stem support of leaves/flowers explicitly support roots and shoots. All translations preserve the contrasting functions.

evidence.quote:
How does salt appear faster in salt beds?

The sun's heat and blowing wind help dry the water in salt beds faster!
